_comment: Reference values for lammps-thermal-conductivity (reworked: the agent builds the 1200-bead system with the provided template script, equilibrates at T*=1.0, quenches to T*=0.4 starting from the T*=1.0 state, runs the 200000-step T*=0.4 NVE production, and reports kappa at T*=0.4). kappa_T04_ref = default-protocol oracle value on the CI image; kappa_tol_frac covers the allowed equilibration-protocol spread (see _calibration_note).
_calibration_note: Calibrated 2026-08-10 on the CI image (Ubuntu 20.04, gcc 9 build of the modified lammps_Ex0; x86_64). The oracle (generate -> equilibrate T*=1.0 -> quench T*=0.4 -> 200k NVE production -> kappa) was run 5x across the allowed equilibration range (150k-500k steps/stage, three Langevin seeds): kappa_T04 = 2.4888 / 2.4571 / 2.5268 / 2.3854 / 2.3738 -> mean 2.446, 1-sigma 0.066 (2.7%). kappa_T04_ref = 2.488754 is the default-protocol oracle value; kappa_tol_frac = 0.15 = max(3 x spread, physical floor) covers every valid equilibration protocol plus the agent's own block-SEM noise. Generated-system box (fixed by the deterministic generator): side=17.800466, V=5640.194954. kappa lower at high T / weaker sticker association; the short quench (vs the 1M-step HPC assets) associates the sticker network less, so kappa here (~2.49) is slightly below the earlier 2.55. The verifier re-runs the pinned generator to byte-verify data.in (L1b) and recomputes kappa from the raw flux series (L6); a fabricated pipeline is caught at L4 (hidden reference) and/or L6.
